name: EDGAR-X
description: Licensing: this is a mixed-licence archive. Code is released under the MIT Licence; documentation, protocol documents and paper materials are released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). EDGAR-X is a point-in-time benchmark for predicting US Chapter 7 or Chapter 11 bankruptcy within 365 days of a Form 10-K, in which every model input is fixed against that filing's EDGAR acceptance timestamp: as-filed financial facts, the industry code carried on the filing, the filer's permanent SEC identifier, and the actual bankruptcy petition date as event time. The panel holds 59,500 Form 10-K observations from 2012 to 2024 carrying 437 bankruptcy-positive observations, of which 54,351 observations and 408 positive observations are testable under rolling temporal evaluation. This archive is an exact, unmodified snapshot of release v1.0.1 of the public repository, generated by GitHub from tag v1.0.1 (commit 014997dab07aac71b8e0ad733d2cf7e96637a2ab).
